evidence_paraphrase: The original SEC issuer exhibit has a San Diego November 25 dateline. The full merger chronology says November 26 premarket publication. The issuer-distributed PRNewswire release expressly records November 26 at 01:10 ET (06:10 UTC), which is November 25 at 22:10 Pacific. Timezone reconciliation is an inference, not an independently proved earliest-public timestamp. The existing November 26 date-only event and conservative civil-time uncertainty bounds are retained; no exact first-public time is invented.
